audience: property managers who use Propertyware for properties, leases and maintenance

useCases.title: Review properties and units
useCases.text: The AI lists buildings and units in your Propertyware account and opens selected records to help you review the properties you manage.

useCases.title: Prepare for lease renewals
useCases.text: The AI finds leases ending next month, reads the lease details and checks saved lease notes to help you prepare renewal follow-ups.

useCases.title: Review maintenance work and tasks
useCases.text: The AI lists work orders, opens a selected order and reviews its tasks so you can assess outstanding maintenance work.

useCases.title: Add a maintenance task or task comment
useCases.text: When requested, the AI adds a task to an existing work order or a comment to an existing task. Repeating either action creates another entry.
